page.overview:
Who is Mr. Kazama?

According to Lili, who, in Tekken 7, claims to know all about Asuka's situation, after Mr. Kazama was beaten by Feng, he lost his students and his livelihood. This left the family too poor to fix Asuka's bike, let alone the family dojo.

Mr. Kazama also made an appearance in the non-canonical Online Tekken Comic.
